description: Facebook page profile — likes vs followers (distinct), talkingAbout, category, website, and public email. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

url.description: Facebook page URL, @handle, or page name, e.g. https://facebook.com/PageName. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: facebook_page_details
title: Facebook Page Details
